q2_gaps: capacity/role 'as + NP' adjunct ('As an official Soviet artist, ...'): no licensed encoding of the 'as' relation itself - it is a preposition over an NP, not a clausal connective, so no connective atom applies and the capacity link between the role and the main clause is simply dropped

dangling adjunct whose implicit subject is not the main clause's subject: no rule says where such an adjunct's referent attaches (here it is resolved to the possessor of 'his work', which is the only coherent reading)
notes: Compound decomposition (genus plus both predicable adjectival modifiers), the appositive Past wrapper on the typing atom, Possession for 'his work', the two agentless passives with Theme, and the surface-form Manner adverbs 'well' / 'widely' all follow the instruction set.
